name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
snapshot: Voters ended Ralph Gonsalves's 24 years in power in November 2025, handing the opposition NDP a landslide and making Godwin Friday prime minister.
culture: The islands mix African, Garifuna, Carib, Portuguese and Indian heritage. Vincy Mas, held in midsummer, is the main carnival. The Garifuna people trace their origins to St Vincent, from which the British deported them in 1797, and their national hero, Chief Joseph Chatoyer, is honoured every March.
society: Agriculture, especially bananas and arrowroot, and tourism in the Grenadines like Bequia and Mustique drive the economy. The La Soufrière volcano erupted in 2021, and Hurricane Beryl in 2024 wrecked Union Island.
situation: In November 2025 the New Democratic Party, led by Godwin Friday, won a large majority, ending the Unity Labour Party government of Ralph Gonsalves, one of the world's longest-serving elected leaders.
power: A parliamentary democracy and Commonwealth realm. The prime minister leads the majority among the 15 elected members of the House of Assembly, which also has appointed senators.

leaders.state: King Charles III, represented by a governor-general
leaders.gov: Prime Minister Godwin Friday, since November 2025
